stem: An online game increases in number of users at a rate of 500 users each day. Which graph best represents the relationship between y, the number of users, and x, the number of days?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with x-axis labeled Time (days) and y-axis labeled Total Number of Users, x values 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, y values 0 to 4.

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with x-axis labeled Time (days) and y-axis labeled Total Number of Users, x values 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, y values 0 to 1,000.

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with x-axis labeled Time (days) and y-axis labeled Total Number of Users, x values 0 to 4, y values 0 to 2,000.

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with x-axis labeled Time (days) and y-axis labeled Total Number of Users, x values 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, y values 0 to 4,000.

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled A, B, C, and D showing different scales and slopes on x-axis (Time in days) and y-axis (Total Number of Users).
notes: Scales on axes preserved as seen, options given in display order with labels.
